Economic Committee

Economic Committee

Members of this Committee were appointed at the 2nd sitting of the 20th People's Majlis, held on 3 June 2024. Under Article 122 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, the responsibility of this Committee is to study economic matters and, where changes need to be made to economic policies, to identify them and submit them to the People's Majlis; and, in relation to the State's economy, to deal with matters relating to the ministry responsible for economic development and trade policies, the ministry responsible for tourism policies, the ministry responsible for fisheries and marine resources policies, the ministry responsible for agriculture policies, the Maldives Customs Service, the Maldives Inland Revenue Authority and the Capital Market Development Authority.

In addition, the Committee's responsibilities include studying and finalising bills relating to its area of work and submitting them to the Majlis for its consideration; studying the annual reports of those offices, identifying matters that need to be corrected and informing those offices of them; studying matters submitted by those offices and advising on how to proceed with them; and meeting those offices, obtaining information and asking questions about the matters they carry out, reviewing how they are carrying out what they are required to do, and setting out the matters that need to be corrected.

The Committee's responsibilities also include submitting the Committee's report to the Majlis after completing all the work required in relation to matters submitted concerning the appointment and removal of persons to and from the Board of the Maldives Inland Revenue Authority.

1. Introduction

This is the report of this Committee's review of the matter sent by the President to appoint a person to the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation, pursuant to Article 8(a) of Law No. 3/2010 (Tax Administration Act), following its referral to this Committee for review at the first sitting of the third session of 2026 of the People's Majlis, held on 5 October 2026.

2. How the Committee carried out its work

As the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation is vacant, and following a public announcement to appoint a person to the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation pursuant to Article 8(a) of Law No. 3/2010 (Tax Administration Act), the President has sent to the People's Majlis the information of those among the applicants whom the President considers suitable for appointment to the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation. Accordingly, the 3 (three) persons whose names the President sent as considered suitable for appointment to the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation are:

1. Mr. Ahmed Shafneez, Bageechaage / S. Hulhudhoo

2. Mr. Ahmed Mausoom, V. Miares

3. Ms. Mariyam Jaidha, Kandugasdhoshuge / K. Dhiffushi

To check whether the requirements set out in Article 9 of Law No. 3/2010 (Tax Administration Act) for a person appointed to the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation are met by the persons whose names the President sent, pursuant to Article 223

[signature]
[stamp]
Economic Committee

(a) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, letters were sent administratively to the institutions listed below to verify information.

1. Department of Judicial Administration;

2. Elections Commission;

3. Ministry of Economic Development, Transport and Trade; and

4. Maldives Correctional Service.

In addition, pursuant to Article 223(f) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, a public announcement was made on 06 October 2026 to find out whether the public had any complaints about the persons whose names the President sent for appointment to the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation. When the announcement period ended on 11 October 2026, no complaint had been submitted by anyone.

After reviewing the information sent by the institutions mentioned above in reply to the letters sent administratively to check whether the persons whose names the President sent for appointment to the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation meet the requirements of the post, and the CVs of those persons sent with the President's letter, the administrative panel announced at the Committee meeting that, among the persons whose names the President sent as considered suitable for appointment to the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation, the requirements set out in Article 9 of Law No. 3/2010 (Tax Administration Act) are met by Mr. Ahmed Shafneez, Bageechaage / S. Hulhudhoo and Mr. Ahmed Mausoom, V. Miares. Following this, under Article 223(b) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, the Committee decided to summon those 2 (two) persons before the Committee and interview them.

When the persons submitted to the Committee as meeting the requirements, among those whose names the President sent for appointment to the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation, were invited to attend the interview, pursuant to Article 223(f) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, their information

[signature]
[stamp]
Economic Committee

they were informed that they had the opportunity to bring a person or a referral who could verify it to the Committee. They were also informed that, as set out in Article 223(v) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, the Committee meeting held to interview them is a meeting open to live broadcast via radio, television or other media, without any additions or omissions.

Pursuant to Article 223 of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, at the Committee's 20th meeting held on 12 October 2026, when the Committee interviewed the persons submitted to the Committee as meeting the requirements, among those whose names the President sent for appointment to the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation, each person was given an opportunity to introduce themselves, and each member was given a maximum of 10 (ten) minutes to question them and for answers. In this interview, they were asked about their vision for the work of the Maldives Inland Revenue Authority (MIRA) and for further strengthening that work, what they intend to do to increase public trust in MIRA, what could be done to increase the capacity of MIRA staff, and their vision for further strengthening the tax system of the Maldives.

After the questioning stage set out in Article 223(lh) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis was completed, the Committee members gave marks as they saw fit to the persons interviewed by the Committee, pursuant to (k) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, taking into account the "Criteria for weighing marks given to persons interviewed for appointment to independent institutions and independent posts" passed by the General Committee under Article 223(n) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis.

The criteria mentioned above state that, among the persons whose names were sent for appointment to posts, the most qualified person/persons shall be those who receive an average of 75% (seventy-five percent) or above in the marks given by Committee members in the interview conducted by the Committee, in line with the criteria in the table below, and that every committee, in the interview it conducted,

A total of 02 Committee meetings were held to review this matter. Committee members spent approximately 01 hour and 35 minutes in those meetings.

Economic Committee

3. Matters noted by the Committee

After the Committee interviewed the persons submitted to the Committee as meeting the requirements, among those whose names the President sent for appointment to the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation, the Committee noted that only one of them has the academic competence to carry out the responsibilities and duties of the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation, knowledge relating to the post and experience in the field of tax, and holds a general vision for developing the field of tax.

4. Committee's decision

After the Committee interviewed the persons submitted to the Committee as meeting the requirements, among those whose names the President sent to appoint a person to the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation pursuant to Article 8(a) of Law No. 3/2010 (Tax Administration Act), and the Committee members gave marks in line with the criteria passed by the General Committee of the People's Majlis under Article 223(n) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, only one person received an average of 75% (seventy-five percent) or above. That is Mr. Ahmed Shafneez, Bageechaage / S. Hulhudhoo, who received 96.20% (ninety-six point two zero percent).

Therefore, as Mr. Ahmed Shafneez, Bageechaage / S. Hulhudhoo received an average of 75% (seventy-five percent) or above, the Committee determined that he is a qualified person for the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation pursuant to Article 8(a) of Law No. 3/2010 (Tax Administration Act). Accordingly, the Committee unanimously passed that this report be submitted to the Majlis, pursuant to Article 223(a) of the Rules of Procedure of the People's Majlis, requesting the People's Majlis to take into account the decision of this Committee and pass approval for the appointment of Mr. Ahmed Shafneez, Bageechaage / S. Hulhudhoo to the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation.

To Honourable Abdul Raheem Abdulla, Speaker of the People's Majlis,

After respectful greetings, I write as follows.

As the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation is vacant, and following a public announcement for the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation pursuant to Article 8(a) of Law No. 3/2010 (Tax Administration Act), I hereby send with this letter the names and information of those among the applicants whom I consider suitable.

1. Mr. Ahmed Shafneez, Bageechaage / S. Hulhudhoo

2. Mr. Ahmed Mausoom / V. Miares

3. Ms. Mariyam Jaidha, Kandugasdhoshuge / K. Dhiffushi

Therefore, I request that the above-mentioned names be submitted to the People's Majlis, and that the Majlis, in a manner it sees fit, pass the name of a person for appointment to the post of Deputy Commissioner General of Taxation and inform me.

Please accept my respects.

13 Rabi' al-Awwal 1448
26 August 2026

Your servant
[signature]
Mohamed Muizzu

People's Majlis
Malé,
Maldives.
